csv_project_name: PD for Naples Bridge Replacement Planning Analysis
csv_scope_of_work: The Local Highway Technical Assistance Council (LHTAC) and Boundary County are seeking qualified and experienced respondents from interested firms to submit a proposal for planning services for the Naples Bridge Planning Analysis project in Boundary County. This consultant will put together a team to analyze and recommend a replacement alternative for the Naples Bridge Planning Analysis. The scope of this planning grant will include public involvement, alternatives analysis, environmental scan, Railroad Coordination, and conclude with a concept report or TS&L as funds allow.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning

title: Planning Analysis for Naples Bridge Replacement
short_description: Planning services for analyzing and recommending a replacement alternative for Naples Bridge.
project_scope: Planning analysis for replacement of the Naples Bridge in Boundary County. Scope includes public involvement, alternatives analysis, environmental scan, railroad coordination, and preparation of a concept report or TS&L (type, size and location study) as funding allows. No technical bridge dimensions, span lengths, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Planning services for bridge replacement analysis; team assembly and coordination; civil, geotechnical, structural, environmental, traffic, and transportation planning input; public involvement; alternatives analysis; environmental review support; railroad coordination; concept report/TS&L preparation.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge replacement project, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- Current procurement is for early planning/alternatives analysis, not detailed bridge design.
- Structural engineering is explicitly requested, creating a potential early entry point.
- No span, structural type, or special engineering features are provided, limiting strategic attractiveness.
- Includes significant planning, environmental, and coordination tasks rather than core structural design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice only covers planning analysis for a bridge replacement, including alternatives analysis, environmental scan, railroad coordination, and a concept report/TS&L. No bridge size, span, width, or replacement concept is given, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The procurement is for planning services only, with scope including public involvement, alternatives analysis, environmental scan, railroad coordination, and concept report/TS&L preparation. Without the detailed RFP scope, effort breakdown, or budget, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced respondents are requested. Disciplines sought include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source excerpt.
